title: Dex the Little Dinosaur’s Big Day
subtitle: A Bold & Easy Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6
hook: A birthday gift kids actually finish.
summary: A pterodactyl friend, a hatching egg and a rumbling volcano.
story: It’s a sunny morning, and Dex can’t wait to explore the jungle. He meets his new friend Pip the pterodactyl, splashes in the pond, helps a giant spotty egg hatch, spots a rumbling volcano, and dances in the rain before a cozy bedtime hug from Mama.
highlights: 29 full-page dinosaur pictures that tell one sweet story
Bold, thick lines that are easy to color
One short sentence in big, clear letters on every page
A “This book belongs to” page for gifting
Extra-large 8.5 x 11 inch pages with room for big crayons
cover_alt: Cover of Dex the Little Dinosaur’s Big Day: Dex waves in the jungle with Pip the pterodactyl and a volcano behind

inside.text: Splash! They jump into the water.
Crack! A baby dino says hello.
Splash! They dance in the rain.
